summary: Moderate repetition. Iran/Hormuz is the 4th straight day — tighten to new facts only. Phrasing crutches ('No mesmo dia', 'em paralelo', 'lançou' 3x, 'a maior X da história', 'para construir', funding formula) and identical section ordering make editions feel structurally interchangeable.
